title: An Industry-Ready Deep Learning Framework for Power Loss Prediction in Half-Cut Photovoltaic Modules
mechanism: Two stages: segment cracks and low-luminescence regions, map the spatial defect features to module power loss, then rebuild I-V with a single-diode model.
adaptation: Template for a half-cut-specific severity stage for E1 (58 half-cut cells, 0 in training). Its point that half-cut current redistribution decouples defect shape from severity argues for a separate half-cut severity rule in the benchmark.
min_experiment: Benchmark-only. Compute the severity track separately for half-cut vs full E1 cells and report whether rankings differ (Kendall tau). No GPU.
evidence: R: 500 half-cut modules; segmentation Dice 0.86; power-loss R2 0.93, MAE 0.0183; reconstructed MPP deviation < 5.5%.
